card.title: IPad Pro 11" Fast battery drain (2% per minute) repair

source.title: IPad Pro 11" Fast battery drain (2% per minute) repair

claims.statement: iPad Pro 11 (2018) draining about 2% per minute usually has power IC U8500 running hot; locate with thermal camera or freeze spray and replace.

card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
